# Big Cats India

> > Customized tiger safari experiences across India's premier wildlife reserves and national parks, specializing in Bengal tiger sightings and wildlife conservation tourism.

Big Cats India offers expert-guided wildlife safaris throughout India's top tiger reserves, including Tadoba, Kanha, Bandhavgarh, and Pench. The site provides comprehensive guides to India's big cats, endangered species, and national parks across Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, and Rajasthan, with specialized safari options for couples, solo female travelers, and vegetarian/Jain food preferences.

- [Golden Tigers in India: India's Rarest Wild Big Cat](https://bigcatsindia.com/golden-tigers-in-india): Rare golden tiger sighting at Kaziranga National Park, Assam
- [Snow Leopard - The ghosts of the Mountains](https://bigcatsindia.com/snow-leopard): Snow leopard guide: habitat, behavior & conservation in the Himalayas
- [Indian Rhinoceros Guide: Species Info, Behavior & Top Safaris](https://bigcatsindia.com/indian-rhinoceros): One-horned Indian rhino guide: behavior, threats & best safari spots
- [10 Endangered Wildlife Species in India That Must be Saved](https://bigcatsindia.com/endangered-wildlife-species-in-india): 10 endangered Indian wildlife species including Blackbuck needing protection
